title: Amazon PPC Lead System
description: Automated system that identifies high-value prospects by scanning agency websites for outdated tech stacks.

full_details.problem: The client was burning 15 hours a week manually checking websites to find sales leads. It was slow, boring, and prone to human error.
full_details.solution: I built a self-hosted n8n workflow. It accepts a list of domains, scrapes the HTML, uses Regex to spot outdated WordPress versions, and auto-qualifies the lead.
full_details.result: The client now wakes up to a list of qualified leads every Monday. Zero manual checking required.

title: LinkedIn Data Extractor
description: A stealth extraction tool that bypasses anti-bot measures to collect public profile data securely.

full_details.problem: Standard scraping tools get blocked by LinkedIn immediately. My client needed market data but couldn't get it reliably.
full_details.solution: I reverse-engineered the internal API calls. Instead of 'attacking' the site, I built a Chrome Extension that piggybacks on valid user sessions to fetch data naturally.
full_details.result: Stable, long-term data collection with zero account flags or IP bans.

title: AI Invoice Accountant
description: An AI agent that reads incoming invoice PDFs (even handwritten ones) and updates the accounting software.

full_details.problem: A business owner was drowning in PDF invoices. OCR tools couldn't read the handwritten notes, leading to hours of data entry.
full_details.solution: I connected Gmail to n8n and OpenAI's Vision model. The AI 'looks' at the PDF like a human would, extracts the specific numbers, and formats them for the database.
full_details.result: Completely removed the owner from the loop. The system handles 100+ invoices a month automatically.
